name: dsh-session-purge
description: DeepSeek Harness maintenance plugin: permanently purge a session (disk log, projection cache, workspace accounting, temp tool outputs, subagent cascade) or redact secrets inside its zstd log in place with the frame layout preserved; plus copyable console instructions for resetting the page UI layout. Entries: Settings panel (session cleanup, grouped by workspace), sidebar row menu (official slot).

dshNotes.redact: in-place zstd redaction requires Node >= 23.8 (runtime feature-detected; without it the redact route returns 501 and everything else keeps working)
